decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts extend the firm's core competencies into a promising but still uncertain wafer-level packaging market, so the option is cheap to keep and its value has not yet resolved for a narrow-range firm with few other options.

The carrier wafer for smaller diameter wafers is a low-cost extension of the established carrier business, fits the firm's strategic direction toward reusable carriers, and its demand uncertainty is still unresolved only one year after launch, so keeping it costs little.
